selection_rule: At 0.05 seconds, minimize total unassigned priority weight, then total priority weighted travel; prefer 256 moves if both tie.
budget_scope: Cooperative optional search after current snapshot and safe greedy baseline; observable total wall time is reported separately.
notes: Pass the parameters explicitly; the class retains its conservative 256-move constructor default.
The result is a feasible heuristic and does not prove optimality.
Any later algorithm tuning requires new development and unused validation seeds.
